main_body: Large leaf canopy (several clumps of leaves) on a thick trunk with root flare at the bottom
top_band: Lightest yellow-green leaf clumps on top of each canopy mass (rows ~1-12), with darker green foliage below; the canopy reads as a rounded volume with lit top and shaded underside
evidence: Organic tree: the canopy shows lit, light-green top clumps stacked over darker green lower masses, with shaded foliage under each clump and a trunk with root flare below. Reads as a volumetric canopy lit from above, matching the reference trees' construction. No receding side face and no flat elevation.

style.evidence: Canopy uses about 5 greens from deep dark green to bright yellow-green, in clumped leaf shapes with per-clump highlights. Trunk and roots use a multi-step brown ramp with a lighter central highlight. Outlines are dark green next to leaves and dark brown next to wood, not black. No large flat fills. Comparable to or richer than the reference trees.
